findings.what: The `attempt` message key uses cardinal ICU plural (`one`/`other`) with hand-added `=2`/`=3` exact matches to fake ordinals, but has no exact match beyond 3, so `attempts` values of 21, 31, etc. would render as "21th run" instead of "21st run". Purely cosmetic and extremely unlikely to be hit in practice (retry counts realistically stay in the single digits), so this is polish, not a defect the ticket promises to avoid.
findings.evidence: apps/web/messages/en.json:547: `"attempt": "{n, plural, one {#st run} =2 {2nd run} =3 {3rd run} other {#th run}}"`. For n=4..20 `other` correctly yields "4th".."20th", but for n=21 it yields "21th run" instead of "21st run".
findings.fix: If ever worth fixing, add explicit `=21`, `=31`, ... exact matches or switch to `selectordinal`; not urgent given realistic attempt counts.
